input: My cat Luna is 14 and has kidney disease. I'm busy 8am to 6pm.

tasks.description: Provide fresh water in multiple easy-to-reach locations
tasks.reason: Cats with kidney disease drink and urinate more; keeping fresh water accessible in several spots encourages drinking.

tasks.description: Serve a small morning meal and monitor appetite
tasks.reason: Senior cats often eat better with smaller, more frequent meals, and tracking appetite helps detect health changes.

tasks.description: Serve an evening meal and observe food intake
tasks.reason: Providing smaller, frequent feedings accommodates senior cat eating habits and allows monitoring of appetite.

tasks.description: Refresh water stations to ensure clean water is continuously available
tasks.reason: Maintaining accessible fresh water in multiple spots promotes essential hydration for cats with kidney disease.

tasks.description: Inspect low-sided litter box access and soft bedding
tasks.reason: Older cats may struggle with tall litter boxes or high surfaces; low-sided boxes and soft bedding support comfort and mobility.
Tracking weight helps identify weight loss or changes in condition to report to the veterinarian.
